package.name: navigate_description
package.description: Section D: the 7-DOF bimanual Kobuki robot - the same base, arms and grippers as the other 7-DOF sections (base, arm and ros2_control xacros identical), with the workspace camera that perceive also carries: a Kobuki-class base with two 7-DOF arms, suction-assisted grippers, a sensor mast (forward RGB camera, workspace camera, 2D LiDAR), ros2_control interfaces and Gazebo Harmonic plugins.
